invariants.claim: Successful entry is from Active or Drawing only; zero-entry Active allows the sponsor before sale end and everyone at/after sale end.
Sold Active raffles require timestamp >= endTime + 2 days; Drawing requires timestamp >= callbackDeadline(), whose zero-timestamp branch returns zero.
On success unsettledPot is zero, remainingRefundLiability equals the old unsettledPot, and status is Refunding.
At their exact deadlines, requests/callbacks stop being eligible while the corresponding refund transition becomes eligible.
The transition makes no external calls or asset transfers; guarded nested entry is rejected before the body.

assumptions.claim: Preexisting refund liability is zero before this first Active/Drawing-to-Refunding transition; otherwise the assignment replaces it.
assumptions.establishedBy: Fresh-clone zero storage; Raffle.sol L94, L176-L205, L279-L299, L349-L368, L421-L428, L509-L523. No independent zero-liability check at L298.

assumptions.claim: Recorded purchase amounts correspond to actual quote-token backing under canonical non-rebasing, fee-free transfer semantics.
assumptions.establishedBy: Raffle.sol L223-L233 credits after safeTransferFrom; trusted-token assumption explicitly documented at L560-L566 and IRaffle.sol L12-L15. Nothing in enableRefunds L276-L301 verifies external balance or semantics.

assumptions.claim: The callback deadline uses the request timestamp recorded by requestDraw; a nonzero timestamp is not asserted by the deadline helper.
assumptions.establishedBy: Raffle.sol L252-L253 writes uint64(block.timestamp); L463-L465 returns zero when that field is zero. The caller only compares against the returned deadline at L290-L291.

assumptions.claim: Block timestamp and transaction rollback follow the trusted chain execution model in the supplied orientation.
assumptions.establishedBy: Supplied 009-request.json orientation; source consumes block.timestamp at Raffle.sol L282-L291 and uses reverts at L283, L287, L291, L293.

calls.propagates: Raffle.sol L458-L460 unconditionally returns uint256(endTime) + two-day DRAW_REQUEST_TIMEOUT (RaffleConstants.sol L33); no status or sender validation.
Raffle.sol L463-L465 returns drawRequestedAt + two-day timeout only if nonzero, otherwise zero; enableRefunds L290-L291 accepts timestamp >= that result.
ReentrancyGuard.sol L69-L73, L88-L100 rejects ENTERED before body and otherwise writes ENTERED. Initial zero is accepted, not just NOT_ENTERED.
ReentrancyGuard.sol L102-L106 writes NOT_ENTERED after successful body; a body revert rolls back transaction state under the supplied execution model.
ReentrancyGuard.sol L112-L118 reads the constant slot and compares exactly with ENTERED; slot constant at L35-L37.
StorageSlot.sol L93-L97 directly binds returned storage reference to the supplied slot using assembly; no branch or external interaction.

callers: External callers at Raffle.sol L276; sponsor-only early empty-sale exception at L280-L284; other eligible paths permissionless at L285-L291.
